_about: Hand-made adjustments to walls.json, applied by walls.py. Each comes from the wall audit of 2026-11-17 (MAP_NOTES.md). Coordinates are page pixels of that floor's page in map-inputs/layout.pdf; walls.py moves them onto the map with the floor's transform, like every traced wall. Walls only: nothing here changes rooms, doors or routes.
_lines: Wall pieces the tracing cannot see, plainly drawn on the plan. 'page' is a polyline [[x, y], ...].

lines.why: Top wall of Discovery Centre, under the 'P' of the text 'PYP 2 Supervisor': navy text drawn over the wall hides it from the tracing (audit G-B08).
Same wall, under the 'S' of 'Supervisor' (audit G-B09).
Cross-bar of the T-shaped wall end in corridor 2-R092: its two arms are shorter than the tracing's minimum piece length (audit 2-M03).
Joins the diagonal wall to the middle of that cross-bar, as drawn (audit 2-M03).

_unchanged: Areas the audit marked UNSURE and that were chosen to stay as first traced: walls.py fills no gaps inside these boxes. 'page_box' is [x0, y0, x1, y1] with 10 px to spare.

unchanged.why: Two lines meeting at a narrow angle on the bottom edge by the stage, west side: step, ramp or drawing slip? (audit 2-M05)
Short black stroke across the door recess of Pre KG C (audit G-B10).
